qualitative_constraints: Only two small pilot orders should exist before takeover.
The original active market must expose only a sparse deterministic order stream after takeover.
Uncommitted inventory and near-term supply should materially exceed the original market's effective order entry.
Raw materials, staffing, cash and warehouse pressure must remain secondary.
Sales should independently assess whether one additional market is justified and continue selecting economically favorable feasible orders.
anti_contamination_rules: Do not inject random formal orders.
Do not reveal preferred order ids or an oracle ranking to Agent or Scripted prompts.
Do not let all formal offers remain available indefinitely.
Do not inject slot-2 orders before a second market is active.
Do not expose should_develop_market or recommended_action to the Agent.
Do not encourage more than one additional market.
Do not introduce prewarm HR, capacity, cash or warehouse shocks.
